newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank Italy determined to keep lira stable-Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Bank Italy determined to keep lira stable-Fazio.

text.p: The Bank of Italy is determined to keep the lira stable, central bank governor Antonio Fazio said, adding that the lira's current level in the ERM safeguarded the competitiveness of Italian industry.

Speaking at a ceremony to receive an honorary degree from the University of Macerata, Fazio said "the action of the Bank of Italy .. remains firmly oriented towards maintaining conditions of stability in the value of the currency."
Fazio also said that average annualised inflation since June had fallen to two percent on a seasonally adjusted basis.

Speaking on the lira, Fazio said the Italian currency had been readmitted to the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM) at a level which "even on the basis of views expressed by the most important international organisations, safeguards the competitiveness of Italian industry."
He also called on industry, banks and public sector employers to keep salary rises and increases in profit margins in line with productivity growth.
"It is necessary that incomes of the main industrial sectors, in the banks and in the public sector and that company margins evolve along a path that does not exceed productivity growth," Fazio said.
